messages.content:
核对生产计划的原题与当前候选模型，必要时修改；候选可能正确，正确时保持不变。
只返回完整模型JSON，不输出答案或解释，不生成代码。保留A、B变量标识符，允许改模型内容。不要因为给了检查结果就假定一定有错，也不要把未检出视为正确证明。
模型须符合以下Schema：
{"type": "object", "properties": {"name": {"type": "string"}, "assumptions": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}}, "variables": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "properties": {"name": {"type": "string"}, "description": {"type": "string"}, "unit": {"type": "string"}, "kind": {"type": "string", "enum": ["integer", "continuous"]}, "lower": {"type": "number"}, "upper": {"type": ["number", "null"]}}, "required": ["name", "description", "unit", "kind", "lower", "upper"], "additionalProperties": false}}, "objective": {"type": "object", "properties": {"sense": {"type": "string", "enum": ["max", "min"]}, "terms": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "properties": {"variable": {"type": "string"}, "coefficient": {"type": "number"}}, "required": ["variable", "coefficient"], "additionalProperties": false}}, "unit": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["sense", "terms", "unit"], "additionalProperties": false}, "constraints": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "properties": {"name": {"type": "string"}, "terms": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "properties": {"variable": {"type": "string"}, "coefficient": {"type": "number"}}, "required": ["variable", "coefficient"], "additionalProperties": false}}, "sense": {"type": "string", "enum": ["<=", ">=", "="]}, "rhs": {"type": "number"}, "unit": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["name", "terms", "sense", "rhs", "unit"], "additionalProperties": false}}}, "required": ["name", "assumptions", "variables", "objective", "constraints"], "additionalProperties": false}

{"problem": "一家工厂计划生产 A、B 两种产品，产量均为非负整数件。
每件 A 的利润为 40 元，耗费 2 小时工时和 1 千克原料；
每件 B 的利润为 30 元，耗费 1 小时工时和 2 千克原料。
本期最多有 100 小时工时、80 千克原料。没有其他约束。
请确定两种产品的产量，使本期总利润最大。
", "current_model": {"name": "生产计划", "assumptions": ["单位利润和资源消耗固定，收益与产量线性相加。", "仅考虑输入中列出的限制；现实条件完整性需用户确认。"], "variables": [{"name": "A", "description": "产品 A 产量", "unit": "件", "kind": "integer", "lower": 0, "upper": null}, {"name": "B", "description": "产品 B 产量", "unit": "件", "kind": "integer", "lower": 0, "upper": null}], "objective": {"sense": "max", "terms": [{"variable": "A", "coefficient": 40.0}, {"variable": "B", "coefficient": 30.0}], "unit": "元"}, "constraints": [{"name": "工时", "terms": [{"variable": "A", "coefficient": 2.0}, {"variable": "B", "coefficient": 1.0}], "sense": "<=", "rhs": 100.0, "unit": "工时"}, {"name": "原料", "terms": [{"variable": "A", "coefficient": 1.0}, {"variable": "B", "coefficient": 2.0}], "sense": "<=", "rhs": 80.0, "unit": "原料"}]}, "solver_result": {"status": "optimal", "values": {"A": 40.0, "B": 20.0}, "objective": 2200.0}, "instruction": "请核对原题，必要时修改；正确时保持。", "program_checks": {"issues": [], "scope": "仅结构、显式全局整数域及候选模型自身验证；未发现问题不证明原题建模正确"}}
